name: trigger_derived_down
comment: ADR-0042 + ADR-0018 on PostgreSQL (ADR-0043): the trigger renders as a function and a trigger; the rollback guards on this version's rendering, drops both, and recreates the previous declaration through the dialect. The live trigger reads back to its declaration from pg_trigger and pg_proc (the lossless catalog).
